name: Dart
creator: Lars Bak and Kasper Lund (Google)
usedFor: Mobile apps with Flutter, web apps
description: Dart is the language used to build Flutter apps. It is fast, easy to learn, and lets one codebase run on Android, iOS, web and desktop.

name: Python
creator: Guido van Rossum
usedFor: Data science, AI, automation, web backends
description: Python is known for its simple and readable syntax, which makes it one of the most popular languages for beginners and experts.

name: Java
creator: James Gosling (Sun Microsystems)
usedFor: Enterprise systems, Android apps, web servers
description: Java follows the idea of 'write once, run anywhere' because its code runs on the Java Virtual Machine on any device.

name: JavaScript
creator: Brendan Eich (Netscape)
usedFor: Interactive websites, web apps, servers with Node.js
description: JavaScript runs in every web browser and makes web pages interactive, such as buttons, forms and animations.

name: C
creator: Dennis Ritchie (Bell Labs)
description: C is one of the oldest languages still widely used. Many modern languages and operating systems were built using C.

name: Kotlin
creator: JetBrains
description: Kotlin is the official preferred language for Android development. It is shorter and safer to write than Java.
